description: Fetch new responses from LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms into leads. LinkedIn has no webhook, so this is a pull: it keeps a per-form position, asks slightly BEHIND it (so two responses with the same timestamp cannot fall through the gap) and de-duplicates on the response id, so a second run creates nothing twice and skips nothing. The first run without a stored position goes back 30 days by default, not to the beginning of time — say since_days to widen it deliberately. Consent is NOT assumed: every lead arrives with marketing_consent unset, because whether the form asked for it is not visible here. Optional: form_id (one form only), since_days, dry_run (show what would be created).

dry_run.description: Fetch and show what would be created, write nothing and do not move the position.

form_id.description: One form URN only. Default: every form on the connected ad account.

since_days.description: Override how far a first run reaches back. Ignored once a position is stored for that form.

name: sync_linkedin_leads
